title: Kelowna: E-bike Rental with Navigation App
includes: Helmet, Sturdy Bike Lock, Cell Phone Holder, Companion App
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
E-bikes offer low cost, energy efficient, and emission-free transportation which also has physical and health benefits. Our e-bikes offer 5 levels of pedal assist power meaning you can travel many kilometres of distance with as little effort as you desire. 

Our e-bikes are equipped with on-demand thumb throttles that gives you an extra boost which activates the motor proportionally no matter if you pedal or not, to give you a fully electric ride in case you cannot pedal or need an instant acceleration or uphill push.

Our chosen fleet model, is a perfect choice with features such as low-step design for easy mount and dismount, super lightweight, stylish and unisex hydro-formed aluminium alloy frame suitable for people from 4’11” to 6’6”, a battery that can handle rides up to 100km range (depending on pedal assist level, rider weight and terrain) and have plenty of power to tackle the hills of the Okanagan.
